Count discharges and contributing hospitals by cell

Source: R/cell-counts.R
nis_cell_counts.Rd

Produces the unweighted discharge and distinct hospital counts used by nis_suppress(). Hospital identity is the year-scoped pair YEAR and HOSP_NIS, matching nis_design(). The input can be a record-level data frame or the result of nis_design(). Rows with invalid hospital identity are rejected so counts cannot silently understate disclosure risk.

Usage

nis_cell_counts(.data, by)

Arguments

.data

Record-level data frame or result of nis_design().

by

Character vector of cell-defining columns.

Value

A data frame with the columns in by, n (unweighted discharges), and hospitals (distinct year-scoped hospitals).

Examples

records <- data.frame(
  YEAR = c(2020, 2020, 2020), HOSP_NIS = c(1, 1, 2), group = c("A", "A", "A")
)
nis_cell_counts(records, by = "group")
#> # A tibble: 1 × 3
#>   group     n hospitals
#>   <chr> <int>     <int>
#> 1 A         3         2
